concerns.text: FR-001 requires human feasibility scores for *all* 1 000 prompts, but FR-009 only mandates collection for at least 200 prompts. The plan assumes 500 conflicting prompts have human scores for paired tests and power analysis (see Research §8), which is inconsistent with the lower annotation budget. This mismatch may leave the study under‑powered and invalidate the planned statistical conclusions.

FR-009’s minimal 200‑prompt annotation contradicts the plan’s reliance on a full 1 000‑prompt human‑annotated dataset for the primary paired analysis. Without sufficient human ground‑truth data, the paired t‑test/Wilcoxon comparison and the claimed power (≈0.85) cannot be justified.
